warnings: price_granularity WARN investigated 2026-08-06 and RESOLVED as a heuristic false positive, not a data defect: NMDC (33.9% distinct-close ratio) traded most of its history at Rs 10-20, where 2-decimal/NSE-tick precision allows only a few hundred valid price levels, making repeats structurally inevitable. Confirmed not stale/halted: volume 1.2M-1B shares/day with zero zero-volume days across 2962 bars, and longest consecutive-identical-close run is only 3-4 days. The other 82/142 instruments below the 90% threshold are larger/higher-priced names where the same low-price-tick-size mechanism applies even less; not individually re-checked. Recommend the gate's price_granularity threshold be scaled by price or raised, rather than continuing to treat this as an open data-quality item.

open_data_quality_questions: Largest daily move is +190.67% and pooled excess kurtosis is 157.62. Both are far outside normal equity behaviour and are consistent with UNADJUSTED corporate actions (splits, bonuses, demergers).

The corporate_actions table must be populated before adjustment defects can be distinguished from genuine events.
Unadjusted actions create overnight gaps that never happened, stopping out every long position in the affected name - this would reproduce the Cycle 1 'everything hits its stop' symptom on real data.

ROOT CAUSE FOUND 2026-08-06: Zerodha's own statement (https://x.com/zerodha/status/1952292763929874868) confirms the Kite historical API adjusts for bonuses/splits/rights/spin-offs/dividends server-side by default, retroactively, at the ex-date. backfill.py's is_adjusted=False label and the 'the Kite provider performs no adjustment' comments in corporate_actions/detector.py, corporate_actions/adjuster.py, and market_data/quality_report.py are themselves the defect, not the market data.

The +190.67% headline largest-move (CGPOWER) is the real 2015-10-01 Crompton Greaves demerger into CG Power (industrial) + Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals - correctly left unadjusted by Kite since spin-offs aren't a simple ratio adjustment. Same no-splice treatment as TATAMOTORS/PEL should apply; CGPOWER should be added to that watch list.

DO NOT run corporate-actions import/apply on ca_candidates.csv as currently written - none of its HIGH_CONFIDENCE rows verified as real, and applying an adjustment on top of data Kite already adjusted would double-adjust and corrupt prices.

INCIDENT 2026-08-06, ROOT-CAUSED AND FIXED (updated from earlier note in this file which said root cause was not found - it has since been found): the configured PostgreSQL store was found empty twice in one session. Root cause: tests/integration/test_db_postgres.py connected to settings.database_url (the real research database, not an isolated test DB) and ran Base.metadata.drop_all() at setup, teardown, AND mid-test in test_alembic_migration_upgrade_path - every ordinary `pytest tests/` run destroyed the real data. Confirmed by reproducing the second wipe immediately after a pytest run in this session.

Fix chain (3 bugs, first 2 previously invisible because they cancelled out): (1) added isolated POSTGRES_TEST_DB=tradecraft_test in config.py with a hard runtime refusal if it ever equals POSTGRES_DB; (2) alembic/env.py's get_url() unconditionally returned settings.database_url, ignoring any Config.set_main_option override - fixed to check config.get_main_option('sqlalchemy.url') first; (3) alembic.ini had a stale hardcoded sqlalchemy.url with the wrong password, invisible only because of bug (2) - blanked out; (4) once (2) was fixed, the test fixture's str(engine.url) turned out to mask the password as '***' by default in this SQLAlchemy version - fixed to use url.render_as_string(hide_password=False). Verified: full pytest tests/ run leaves the real database's 18-table schema unchanged (direct \dt before/after), all 6 previously-broken test_db_postgres.py tests now pass.

This standing risk is CLOSED, not worked around: pytest tests/ is now safe to run repeatedly and will never touch the real research database again. Recovery for both wipes: alembic upgrade head + full data backfill re-run, verified via direct SQL query.
